name: sub2api

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: **Required.** Password for the dashboard sign-in at /login. Any password you like; a long one is harder to guess. **This install needs the [Workers Paid plan](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/) ($5/month to Cloudflare) for Containers.** On Workers Free, use the [Workers-only install (beta)](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/PlaygrndLabs/sub2api/tree/main/worker) instead.
